create.name: Andrea Belzer
create.bio:
Andrea Belzer is a spiritual and energy healer, Reiki master and mediumship reader who works from the Pittsburgh area of Pennsylvania, seeing some clients in person and most by video or phone. She came to this work in midlife after a first career shaped by finance and an MBA, when years of self-improvement and a Catholic upbringing no longer gave her the answers she was looking for. Her training since has included Reiki, meditation teaching, past-life regression, shamanic journeying and mediumship with teachers such as Sandra Ingerman and Betsy Bergstrom, and an end-of-life doula certificate from the University of Vermont.

Her sessions combine Reiki and chakra clearing with messages from a client's spirit guides, and she also offers divination readings, spiritual mentoring, the tending of homes and land, and companionship for families facing a death. Her self-paced audio course, Energetic Sovereignty, teaches everyday energy care: noticing your own state, setting energetic boundaries and clearing what you pick up from others. On her YouTube channel she shares short Reiki-infused guided meditations for moon phases, grounding and letting go of old patterns, some in Portuguese, and she has a following on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Energetic Sovereignty: Reclaiming Authority Over Your Energy
courses.description: A self-paced course of fourteen audio lessons, each with a written version, meant to be worked through over about a month. It covers knowing your own energetic state, a daily energy-care routine, protecting yourself from other people's energy and clearing it afterwards. One-to-one coaching can be added.

courses.title: Illumination Session (Energy and Spiritual Healing)
courses.description: Her core session, by video or in person near Pittsburgh. She clears the client's energy field with Reiki and chakra work, addresses small spiritual blocks, and ends with practical guidance received from the client's spirit guides. A monthly subscription option is offered.

courses.title: Spiritual Reading and Mediumship Sessions
courses.description: Guidance readings drawing on channelled messages, mediumship, shamanic journeying and tarot or oracle cards. Clients can send a single question for a distance reading or book a live half-hour call.
courses.price: $99 USD (distance, one question); $129 USD (30-minute video or phone session)

courses.title: Spiritual Life Coach and Mentor
courses.description: A monthly mentoring package that pairs coaching calls and written support during the week with an Illumination session and a Reiki video made for the client. It is aimed at people who want to bring spiritual practice into their goals and daily life.

courses.title: End-of-Life Doula Services
courses.description: Support for a dying person and their family as they make decisions and explore their feelings and beliefs about death, drawing on her doula training and on shamanic death traditions. Offered as packages of calls, with written support available too.
